description: Search a device for bad blocks.

option.name: -b
tip: Specify the block size in bytes (default 1024).

option.name: -B
tip: Use buffered I/O instead of direct I/O.

option.name: -c
tip: Specify the number of blocks tested at a time (default 64).

option.name: -d
tip: Sleep between reads when no errors were found.

option.name: -e
tip: Abort after this many bad blocks (0 means never abort).

option.name: -f
tip: Force a read-write or non-destructive test on a mounted device.

option.name: -i
tip: Read a list of known bad blocks from the file and skip testing them.

option.name: -o
tip: Write the bad block list to the file instead of standard output.

option.name: -p
tip: Repeat scanning until no new blocks are found for this many passes.

option.name: -s
tip: Show rough percentage completion while scanning.

option.name: -t
tip: Specify a numeric test pattern or random.

option.name: -X
tip: Internal flag used by e2fsck and mke2fs to bypass the in-use device check.
